caption: Three project notes in columns, with properties in rows.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['bases-transpose-table']; const open=async(name)=>{await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Transpose Table/Project comparison.base#'+name,'',false);for(let i=0;i<100;i++){const v=p.targetView(); if(v && v.config.name===name && v.containerEl.querySelector('.btt-title') && v.sheet.names.length===(name==='Six notes'?5:3)) return v; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} throw Error('View did not render');}; p.pro.signOut(); await open('Compare'); return 'ok';})()
